prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: standalone chapter illustration for a refined Hong Kong flute knowledge website.
Style: sophisticated literary arts journal editorial illustration, handmade paper grain, charcoal linework and matte gouache, quiet observational detail, evocative rather than technical.
Composition: wide 3:2 landscape, beautifully balanced with breathing room and natural asymmetry. No border.
Palette: deep forest green and near-black ink, warm cream paper, restrained copper accents, realistic silver when a flute is shown.
Constraints: no people or body parts, no text or captions, no logos or watermarks, no readable notation, no fake historical documents, no invented anatomical or instructional diagrams. Any visible flute must be recognizable as a modern Western concert flute. Keep instrument details plausible and unobtrusive.
Subject: A traditional wooden pendulum metronome beside a plain pencil and gently folded music score, viewed obliquely on a worn reading table. Notation remains soft and out of focus, not a readable document. Late morning directional light, angular shadows suggesting pulse, a little restrained copper in the warm wood.
